caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded jar or vase with a wide body, narrow base, and an open mouth with multiple ridges or rings around the neck. The object is rendered in shades of brown, resembling polished wood or pottery with visible grain or marbling patterns. The background of the drawing is an off-white or cream color, and there are no other objects or elements present in the composition. The jar is centered in the image, and there is a small artist’s signature near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Maple Vase
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
